test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘SPIRIT’ is written as ‘WKMIMG’. How will ‘GLOBAL’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :

**First letter is added with +4.**

**Second letter is opposite of that letter and it is repeated.**

‘SPIRIT’ is written as ‘WKMIMG’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc8cedca9956085bbf80a02652c3c1aca87fd93ed3bc151b54871df1ca25ab46.png] 

Similarly,

‘GLOBAL’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d90c738e3bf15d6f39b1d3d91a92f52041fd041d7408d38db3666ca27ec033a2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"KOSYEO".**
